map.URL 编码空间占比 使用指南: URL Encoding Space Ratio — User Guide
map.输入原始 URL 或参数串，工具估算经百分号编码后相比原文的体积增长比例，帮助你: Enter an original URL or parameter string to estimate how much percent-encoding grows it relative to the original, helping you anticipate bloat of long parameters in links.
map.每个非 ASCII/特殊字符编码为 %XX（3 字符）空格编码为 %20 或 +: Each non-ASCII/special character encodes to %XX (3 characters); space encodes to %20 or +
map.链接体积规划：评估中文/符号密集参数编码后的膨胀率。: Link size planning: assess the bloat rate of Chinese/symbol-dense parameters after encoding.
map.存储预算：URL 入库前预估编码后字段宽度。: Storage budget: estimate the encoded field width before storing a URL.
map.对比分析：横向比较不同参数集的编码开销。: Comparative analysis: compare encoding overhead across parameter sets.
map.示例：含 10 个中文的参数: Example: a parameter with 10 Chinese characters
map.：约 30 字节原文编码后约 90 字符，膨胀约 200%（每中文字≈9 字符）: : about 30 bytes originally becomes about 90 characters after encoding, roughly 200% bloat (each Chinese character ≈ 9 characters).
map.占比衡量相对膨胀，长度工具给绝对字符数，二者互补。: The ratio measures relative bloat, while the length tool gives absolute character counts; the two complement each other.
map.为何中文膨胀这么大？: Why does Chinese bloat so much?
map.UTF-8 每中文字 3 字节，编码为 %XX 各 3 字符，故约 3×。: Each Chinese character is 3 bytes in UTF-8, and each byte becomes a 3-character %XX, so about 3×.
map.可对整段先做 Base64Url 或改用短编码，但会牺牲可读性。: You can Base64Url the whole segment or switch to a short encoding, but that sacrifices readability.
